context:
Goal: q_max shows past rates the way you look them up.
Problem (goal): PR #700, "Past Rates: By Year and By City views" (Oct 12), never merged. Its history no longer shares a base with main, so it cannot merge as it is: 65 commits, about 3,500 lines.
Based on (read): lane qmax-revive-idle found the feature is not on main.
Departs from: main, where Past Rates has no By Year or By City view — option a adds both.
No recommendation: it depends on whether you still look up past rates by year or by city. #700 stays open until you answer.

options.gain: You get the By Year and By City views you asked for in October.
options.label: Port it: a lane rebuilds both views from main, with a design check
Close it
options.lose: The two views are gone. The PR stays on GitHub if you want them later.

short: #700 Past Rates views: port or close
title: q_max PR #700 (Past Rates by year and by city) cannot merge: rebuild the two views, or close it?
why: The PR has sat since Oct 12 and its history no longer fits main.
